transcript: It's time for you to go. -Bye, guys. -MIKE: Bye, Aaliyah. Bye. Well, if there's a silver lining to coming to Tribal Council tonight, it is that waiting for you back at camp will be your pot, your flint -and your machete. -Whoo! (indistinct chatter) PROBST: Grab your torches. Head back to camp. Good night. Captioning sponsored by CBS Captioned by Media Access Group at WGBH access.wgbh.org You wanted Survivor, you got Survivor. You wanted Survivor, you got Survivor. Aah! PROBST:Next time on Survivor... -(groaning) -PROBST: Big fall. I made a mistake. (groaning) Oh. Holy ... I think what went wrong was I just wasn't good at playing Survivor as I thought I was. Especially now, embarrassing,that I'm first one out. Shout out Jelly, shout out Dev, my number one allieswho went to bat for me. Obviously, I have no ill willtowards them. But ultimately, I'm just really, really, really grateful that I got this opportunityto do this. That's something I'm really, really proud of.

votes_were_read.instructions: The host read votes aloud at this tribal council.

vote_decided_exit.instructions: The castaway who left at this tribal council was decided by the votes read aloud, rather than by a fire-making challenge, a rock draw, or any other tiebreaker.

fire_challenge_occurred.instructions: A fire-making challenge was held at this tribal council.

revote_occurred.instructions: The first vote ended in a tie and the castaways voted a second time at this tribal council.

any_advantage_played.instructions: At least one castaway played an idol or advantage at this tribal council. A shot in the dark does not count.

any_shot_in_the_dark_played.instructions: At least one castaway played their shot in the dark at this tribal council.

attended_aaliyah.instructions: Aaliyah was present at this tribal council. Being mentioned or talked about by someone who is present does not count.
